title: Transportability from Los Angeles: different age distribution
content: Figure 10.2(b) retains the Arkansas causal graph and adds selector S -> Age Z because the Los Angeles survey population is younger. Transport requires reweighting for Age.

variables.name: Purchase Decision (Y)
variables.content: Whether the consumer purchases the product.

variables.name: Age (Z)
variables.content: Age, the population characteristic that differs from Arkansas.

variables.name: Click-through Rate (W)
variables.content: The mediator between advertisement and purchase.

variables.name: Population Difference (S)
variables.content: The difference-producing selector for the Los Angeles age distribution.

arrows.because: The target causal structure has Age causing Advertisement exposure.
The target causal structure has Age causing Purchase Decision.
